input: i have a tentative opinion that it would be beneficial to work on projects that are hard enough enough that they can't be completed in 20 hours or less of human coding. ... doc_friction.issue: Fetching a branch into the shallow clone without --depth pulled the full history (5 GB) before it was stopped; `git fetch --depth=40 origin <branch>` plus `--deepen=300` on main was enough to merge.

deviations.why: PR #8711 already built the podcast but had sat conflicted since 2026-10-20; merged its branch into this one and resolved it rather than building a second podcast system, so landing this PR lands #8711's commits too.

notes: Owner direction 2026-10-21 (aim at work past ~20 human hours / 15 agent minutes) published as a post, a voiced 3:10 episode, a goals.md paragraph and a CLAUDE.md line.
